Name: Addguests (ex Campings.com)
Description: Campings.Com offers over 3500 campsites across France and Europe. Users can book stays at the best prices in a variety of accommodations, including mobile homes, chalets, bungalows, cottages, and unique lodging options. The platform helps travelers find the perfect campsite for their vacations, ensuring a wide selection of destinations throughout Europe.

Name: Alan
Description: Alan offers comprehensive health solutions combining prevention and insurance for individuals and businesses of all sizes. From startups and SMEs to large corporations, Alan simplifies health management, ensuring employees' well-being. Their mobile app provides access to various health professionals and services, with quick reimbursements and zero paperwork for optical needs. Alan also addresses mental health, with fast customer service and dedicated support. With a user rating of 4.6/5, Alan is a reliable health partner.

Name: Ankorstore
Description: This platform offers access to over 30,000 unique brands with a minimum purchase of €100 and free delivery on the first order. It ensures guaranteed catalog prices with a refund of the difference if prices are not met. Customers can also benefit from extended payment terms of up to 60 days.

Name: BackMarket
Description: Back Market offers refurbished products up to 70% cheaper than new, with free standard shipping and a minimum 12-month warranty. They have been awarded the best e-commerce site by users. Products undergo rigorous vetting to ensure quality and come with a commercial guarantee and a 30-day return policy. Refurbished devices have a lower environmental impact and Back Market also provides trade-in and recycling services, covering shipping costs for returns.

Name: BlaBlaCar
Description: BlaBlaCar connects drivers with empty seats to passengers seeking rides across Europe. The platform offers affordable travel solutions through carpooling and bus services. BlaBlaCar emphasizes safety by verifying member information and fostering a trusted community. With advanced app technology, booking a trip is simple and quick. The service includes various discounts and incentives, such as the Prime Covoiturage. BlaBlaCar promotes environmental impact reduction and social connections, boasting millions of users and significant CO2 savings.

Name: Chapsvision
Description: Groupe ChapsVision specializes in enterprise software solutions, including Data solutions, unified commerce, CRM tools, and marketing automation. Founded in 2019 by Olivier Dellenbach, the company focuses on leveraging data to enhance customer engagement and organizational performance. With over 1,000 employees and 600 major clients, ChapsVision achieved 20% revenue growth in 2023. It has made numerous strategic acquisitions to expand its offerings in cyber intelligence, cybersecurity, and customer engagement. The company emphasizes innovation, quality service, and real-time data interconnection.

Name: Contentsquare
Description: Contentsquare is a leading digital experience platform that aids in optimizing user digital experiences. With over 1,300 clients and 1.3 million SMB customers, it operates with 1,900 employees across 17 offices globally. Contentsquare analyzes trillions of behaviors and holds certifications including ISO 27001, ISO 27701, and SOC 2 Type 2.

Name: DentalMonitoring
Description: DentalMonitoring offers advanced AI-powered solutions for orthodontic practices, enabling enhanced patient care, practice growth, and operational efficiency. Developed by Dental Monitoring SAS, the product supports healthcare professionals in remotely monitoring intraoral conditions and orthodontic treatments. It includes modules recognized as medical devices in Europe and other regions, bearing the CE mark. Patients use it under mandatory professional supervision. The innovation aims to improve care quality and optimize workflows for dental professionals.

Name: DNAScript
Description: DNA Script offers Enzymatic DNA Synthesis (EDS) technology, including the SYNTAX System, the first DNA printer using EDS. The SYNTAX System allows for on-demand, in-house production of custom DNA oligos, with convenient, fast, and flexible workflows. EDS provides significant advantages in terms of accessibility, control, and environmental impact. DNA Script aims to revolutionize genomics research and personalized medicine through continual innovation in enzyme engineering and DNA synthesis technology. The company values excellence, transparency, and benevolence.

Name: Doctolib
Description: Doctolib allows users to quickly find specialists nearby and book appointments online for free with just a few clicks. For any questions or assistance, users can consult the Help Center or contact support.

Name: Ecovadis
Description: EcoVadis offers global SaaS solutions for business sustainability, helping companies manage risks and compliance across supply chains. Their services include universal CSR evaluations, risk assessments, and emissions reduction tools. EcoVadis supports clients like Air France, Atos, and Nestlé by providing detailed supplier evaluations and improvement plans, enhancing sustainability practices. The platform includes customized questionnaires, e-learning modules, and performance dashboards, aiding companies in meeting CSR objectives and creating mutual value and positive impacts.

Name: Ekwateur
Description: Ekwateur is a French green energy provider offering 100% renewable energy options sourced locally or from Europe, with guarantees of origin ensuring the authenticity of their green energy supply. Since 2016, Ekwateur has aimed to contribute to the energy transition and reduce clients' carbon footprints. Their customer service, available six days a week, is highly rated and collaboratively managed by their own clients. They have received multiple awards, including Next 40, Bcorp, and FrenchTech120.

Name: Electra
Description: Electra offers fast-charging stations for electric vehicles, promising an easy and reliable experience. Their "Superchargers" provide quick charging, with 400 km achieved in 20 minutes. Stations can be reserved, ensuring no waiting time. The company aims to give users freedom and save time while promoting a cleaner, more serene world. Located conveniently, Electra focuses on making every moment enjoyable by providing the fastest market charging solutions.

Name: Equativ
Description: Equativ is a digital marketplace for advertisers and a monetization solution provider for publishers. Focused on transparency and performance, Equativ helps customers optimize their advertising activities and campaigns. Born as Smart AdServer, Equativ champions fairness, efficiency, and innovation, collaborating with various industry stakeholders for over two decades. Strategic acquisitions like DynAdmic and LiquidM have propelled its growth, making it a leading, independent ad tech company dedicated to quality and respect.

Name: Exotec
Description: Exotec enhances distribution with the Skypod system, deploying robots to deliver items directly to warehouse operators. Their solutions streamline order processing sustainably, accurately, and cost-effectively. Exotec offers agile robotics powered by sophisticated software, scalable systems, and improved productivity. Their technology addresses various sectors, transforming supply chains through automation and innovation. Notable collaborations include Renault Group and VST, highlighting Exotec's role in advancing logistics. Their culture emphasizes rapid growth and continuous evolution.

Name: iad
Description: Since its inception, iad has experienced rapid success, becoming the ideal partner for life changes. Founded in 2008 in a garage, iad has evolved into the most innovative real estate network. It assists individuals in selling, acquiring, or renting properties. iad is now the leading European network of independent real estate advisors, boasting over 350 employees and 18,000 advisors across 8 countries, with nearly 90,000 properties online and over 800,000 projects completed. They welcome real estate enthusiasts and those seeking new professional challenges.

Name: Ilek
Description: Ilek is a French supplier of green electricity and gas, serving over 150,000 homes at competitive prices. Customers can sign up in just 5 minutes and monitor their energy consumption through the ilek client portal, which also offers discounts and easy access to documents. The company promises quick customer service responses and uses local production sites, including wind farms, hydroelectric dams, solar plants, biomethanizers, and biomass facilities.

Name: Innovafeed
Description: Innovafeed is a biotechnology company focused on breeding insects, specifically Hermetia Illucens, for animal and plant feed. Using proprietary technology, Innovafeed aims to reposition this insect at the core of the food chain.

Name: Ledger
Description: Ledger offers secure solutions for managing crypto-assets like Bitcoin, Ethereum, and more. With the Ledger Live app, users can manage and grow their digital assets, track cryptocurrencies, explore services, and access numerous supported cryptos. Ledger's hardware wallets are compatible with over 50 software wallets, providing enhanced security and peace of mind. Users appreciate the reliability for safeguarding their digital assets. The platform also features an FAQ section for additional support.

Name: Malt
Description: Malt is a freelance platform where users can find the best independent experts to accelerate their projects. Freelancers can receive mission offers aligned with their skills, communicate with over 70,000 potential clients, and handle administrative tasks with Malt's online tools. Payments are quick and missions are guaranteed. Malt also supports freelancers with resources, partnerships, events, and peer learning programs to boost their careers.

Name: ManoMano
Description: ManoMano is an extensive online store specializing in DIY, renovation, and gardening products. They offer a wide range of items at competitive prices, including toilets, home alarms, air conditioners, garden swings, inflatable spas, circular saws, memory foam mattresses, and more. ManoMano provides free and fast shipping options and features expert advice for sustainable living. The platform boasts millions of products and a substantial selection more extensive than traditional stores, making it a comprehensive resource for various home improvement needs.

Name: Mirakl
Description: Mirakl is a leading SaaS solution for managing third-party marketplaces and dropshipping businesses. It offers scalable, secure, and intuitive technology to drive digital growth and profitability. Mirakl's platform supports diverse commerce needs, from retail media to payments, and streamlines processes such as seller onboarding and catalog integration. With a robust ecosystem of quality sellers and partners, Mirakl enables businesses to scale efficiently. Since its founding in 2012, Mirakl has empowered over 400 enterprises worldwide to thrive in the platform economy.

Name: Mistertemp’ group
Description: Mistertemp’ group combines the digital interim leader "Mistertemp’" with a network of 200 local agencies under the brands Aquila RH, Lynx RH, and Vitalis Médical. Their mission is to digitalize while maintaining a human touch, ensuring trustworthy interim solutions. Founded in 2009 by Alexandre Pham and Rémy Sultan, the group operates in France, Italy, and Canada. With numerous accolades, including certifications and awards for recruitment excellence, Mistertemp' group enables project leaders to open recruitment agencies with limited personal investment. They focus on digital recruitment, expert consultants, and a franchise model.

Name: Mistral AI
Description: Frontier AI specializes in open-source generative AI technologies to promote trust, transparency, and decentralized tech development. Their models—Mistral 7B, Mixtral 8x7B, and Mixtral 8x22B—are customizable, under the Apache 2.0 license, and available via serverless APIs, cloud services, or on-premise deployment. The company prioritizes independence, rigorous research, and customer-driven solutions, ensuring efficient and high-performance AI applications. They offer tailored AI solutions and are known for their creative and transparent team dynamics.

Name: NW
Description: NW is an independent operator specializing in high-power electric vehicle charging stations, distributed electricity storage units, and renewable energy production centers. As the first French unicorn in the energy transition sector, NW leads in electricity storage in France and is a pioneer in high-power charging. With 35 years of experience, NW offers competitive pricing and reliable solutions designed in France, catering to both rural and peri-urban areas. NW is recognized for innovation and is a label holder of French Tech Next40.

Name: PayFit
Description: PayFit is an HMRC-recognized payroll software that automates payroll and HR tasks for small and medium businesses. Trusted by over 16,000 companies, PayFit simplifies payroll management with user-friendly workflows, real-time updates, and seamless integrations with HR systems like Personio and BambooHR. The cloud-based platform automates tasks such as payments, HMRC submissions, and expense management, allowing businesses to save time and reduce manual errors. PayFit also offers an all-in-one HR solution, managing everything from onboarding to benefits.

Name: Pennylane
Description: Pennylane is an all-in-one financial management and accounting platform tailored for business owners and their accountants. It combines tools and integrations for managing expenses, billing, cash flow, and accounting in one place. Trusted by over 180,000 leaders, independents, and financial directors, Pennylane aims to reduce financial and accounting management time significantly. It offers features like team expense management, client billing, payment reconciliation, and secure purchasing management, all seamlessly integrated with accounting systems.

Name: Pigment
Description: Pigment is an all-in-one business planning platform designed for finance and revenue teams. It offers real-time planning and forecasting, dynamic reporting, scenario modeling, data syncing, and cross-functional collaboration. Pigment supports integrations with platforms like NetSuite, Salesforce, and Google BigQuery. Founded by professionals from companies like Google and Facebook, Pigment aims to provide an efficient alternative to traditional spreadsheets. They have offices in Paris, London, Toronto, and New York City, and offer a hybrid work setup.

Name: Qair
Description: Qair Energy is an independent renewable energy company focused on long-term energy security through a diverse energy mix. They deliver both mature renewables like wind and solar PV, as well as advanced technologies such as offshore wind, green hydrogen, and storage. Their expertise and strategic partnerships enable them to provide reliable and adaptable energy solutions.

Name: Qonto
Description: Qonto offers a comprehensive business account solution with features such as invoicing, bookkeeping, expense management, and financing. The account includes free Mastercards, instant international transfers, and local IBANs. Users can streamline their invoice and expense management while maintaining control over team expenses. The service provides real-time cash flow insights and is integrated with 40+ applications. Qonto is known for excellent customer support, available in five languages, and ensures account security with 3D-Secure and Strong Customer Authentication.

Name: SAFTI
Description: SAFTI, a network of real estate advisors, offers property listings for houses, apartments, and land. They provide quick property valuations and exclusive listings, including virtual tours. SAFTI is part of the "French Tech Next40" and partners with leboncoin for a major publicity campaign. They also offer AI photo editing for seller listings. The SAFTI Connect app allows users to share real estate information and earn rewards. Follow SAFTI on social media for updates.

Name: Shift Technology
Description: Shift Technology applies AI to automate and optimize insurance decisions for enhanced speed and accuracy. Their solutions detect fraud, analyze claims data, and support compliance efforts across various insurance functions. With deep AI expertise and a large data science team, Shift ensures high accuracy, explainability, and easy integration. Established in 2014 and headquartered in Paris, they serve leading insurers worldwide, handling millions of claims annually. Shift aims to transform insurance decisions, fostering better customer experiences and operational efficiency.

Name: Sorare
Description: Sorare is a platform where users can collect, play, and win officially licensed digital cards featuring top football, NBA, and MLB players. The website requires JavaScript and a supported browser to function properly.

Name: Spendesk
Description: Spendesk provides an all-in-one spend management solution offering control and visibility over the entire expense process while automating administrative tasks. It allows finance teams to collect 98% of receipts automatically, close accounts four times faster, and gain full visibility over operational expenses. The platform supports an unlimited number of users and payment methods, and entails no setup fees. Over 5,000 finance professionals use Spendesk for its efficiency in tracking expenses and streamlining financial reporting.

Name: Swile
Description: Swile offers an employee engagement solution through a powerful digital card and app. The Swile App enables contactless payments, real-time notifications, and the option to order up to three Swile Cards. It simplifies everyday operations, supports digitalization, and reduces environmental impact. Swile provides a customer-centric service for meal and gift vouchers, ensuring employees have flexible spending options. They offer resources for HR and CSE decision-makers, emphasizing time-saving and process anticipation, making them a vital partner in workplace management.

Name: Verkor
Description: Verkor is accelerating low-carbon battery production with the construction of Europe’s largest gigafactory in Dunkirk. Recently, they secured over €1.3 billion in green financing and launched a recruitment campaign for 1,200 permanent employees. Established in 2020, Verkor aims to bolster sustainable industrial production in Europe. The company is focused on producing ecological batteries and supporting renewable energy, contributing to a circular and inclusive economy. Verkor's gigafactory is expected to power 300,000 cars annually with an initial capacity of 16 GWh.

Name: Vestiaire Collective
Description: Vestiaire Collective is a platform for buying and selling second-hand designer pieces, featuring 3 million items from over 12,000 brands. Offering savings of up to 70%, the site ensures authenticity through expert verification. First-time sellers benefit from free sales fees.

Name: Voodoo
Description: Voodoo entertains millions of users globally each month with its games and apps.

Name: Weezevent
Description: Weezevent offers an intuitive suite of services for event ticketing, access control, cashless payments, and attendee management. Users can easily launch and customize their ticketing without technical skills, and retain full control over their data. The platform allows the creation of personalized e-tickets, badges, and confirmations, and offers customizable modules to integrate with existing websites. Weezevent supports events of all sizes with powerful technology and provides ongoing assistance throughout the event lifecycle.

Name: Younited
Description: Le Crédit 100% en Ligne propose une demande de crédit rapide avec une réponse définitive immédiate et une mise à disposition express des fonds grâce à une technologie avancée. Le service client est disponible pour assistance, et la satisfaction des clients est élevée, avec une note moyenne de 4,8/5. Les utilisateurs peuvent gérer leurs crédits, consulter l'état de leurs demandes, et accéder à des services additionnels. Des guides sur diverses options de financement, tels que le crédit à taux zéro, sont également disponibles.

Name: 360 learning
Description: 360Learning is a comprehensive learning platform that facilitates team collaboration to create, deliver, and improve courses. It leverages AI to turn in-house experts into L&D collaborators for efficient upskilling. Services include compliance training, employee onboarding, sales enablement, and frontline staff training. Recognized in the Gartner Market Guide for Corporate Learning Technologies, the platform is ISO 27001 certified, GDPR-compliant, and utilizes secure global hosting providers.

Name: Adagio
Description: Adagio.io is a platform trusted by publishers and SSPs to enhance revenue and profitability. It optimizes ad requests through performance predictions and adapts floor prices to counter DSP bid shading. The platform offers traffic shaping control, minimizes bid waste, and facilitates seamless management and insights, including AB testing and benchmarks. Adagio.io supports connection to new demand sources with one click, improving user experience by reducing client-side connections and optimizing timeouts.

Name: Agicap
Description: Agicap is a leading cash flow management software solution designed to manage cash flow, pay invoices, and track account receivables. Trusted by over 7,000 finance teams, Agicap offers forecasting accuracy, increased financial income, and centralized cash management. The cloud-based system provides comprehensive support, including seamless integration with existing ERP systems. It facilitates smooth and quick implementation, enabling centralized financial data management. Agicap is ideal for organizations seeking efficient, automated cash management.

Name: Agriconomie.com
Description: Agriconomie is an online platform tailored for farmers, offering competitive prices on a vast range of agricultural products, including fertilizers, seeds, spare parts, and various maintenance supplies. With a user-friendly interface, Agriconomie ensures quick delivery and excellent customer service. The site is highly recommended for its efficiency and reliability, providing valuable information and solutions such as proper storage techniques for silage, seed planting tips, and equipment maintenance advice. They are praised for their responsive support and quality service.

Name: Akeneo
Description: Akeneo is a global leader in Product Information Management (PIM) and Product Experience (PX). Its intuitive platform, Akeneo Product Cloud, helps businesses manage and enrich product information, enhancing productivity and efficiency. With a strong partner network and extensive app store, Akeneo supports seamless data management, AI-powered tools, and comprehensive product experiences. Over 700 enterprise customers, including major brands like Chico's and TaylorMade Golf, leverage Akeneo's solutions to optimize their product records across various channels. Offices are located in the U.S., Europe, and Australia.

Name: Aledia
Description: Aledia develops advanced microLED technology for next-generation display screens. Their 3D nanowire and silicon-based microLEDs enable multifunctional, intelligent, and eco-friendly displays that are transparent, foldable, and interactive. Manufactured in France, these screens offer unmatched image quality, energy efficiency, and durability. Aledia holds nearly 300 patent families and employs a dedicated R&D team, ensuring unique and superior products. Their microLEDs have versatile applications, from smartwatches and smartphones to large TVs and augmented reality devices.

Name: Alma
Description: Alma offers a payment solution allowing customers to pay in full, in installments, or later, enhancing their payment experience and boosting merchant turnover by 20%. Merchants receive immediate payment while Alma handles the rest, offering a hassle-free, paperless service. Testimonials from various business leaders praise Alma for its ease of integration, intuitive interface, and significant impact on sales and online conversions. The solution also helps customers better manage their budgets and expenses.

Name: Anywr
Description: Anywr provides comprehensive HR services including recruitment, international mobility, and training. They assist over 500 global clients with immediate staffing in IT, engineering, and life sciences. Their services encompass headhunting for executive roles, Recruitment Process Outsourcing (RPO), HR consulting, and various relocation and immigration solutions. Additionally, Anywr offers training in languages, intercultural communication, HR, compliance, and employability. With over 1000 experts across 14 countries, Anywr combines human expertise and technological solutions to address talent needs worldwide.

Name: Aqemia
Description: Aqemia is an in silico drug discovery start-up focusing on rapidly discovering therapeutic molecules with higher success rates. Utilizing quantum-inspired physics and machine learning, Aqemia generates its own data for drug discovery projects, offering unprecedented speed and accuracy. Founded in 2019 as a spin-off from École normale supérieure, it has grown to a team of 50+ and collaborates with major pharmaceutical companies. The company aims to scale drug discovery and create biotech spin-offs for clinical trials.

Name: Braincube
Description: Braincube is an IIoT platform suite with professional and expert applications designed for manufacturing. It offers cloud and edge solutions to enhance operations, maximizing human potential, increasing profits, and transitioning to autonomous factories. Founded in 2007 by engineers Laurent Laporte, Sylvain Rubat du Mérac, and Hélène Olphe-Galliard, Braincube supports over 250 production sites globally. The company maintains a startup spirit, continuously innovating and recruiting top talent to deliver business-oriented, ROI-guaranteed solutions for industrial competitiveness.

Name: Brevo
Description: Brevo (formerly Sendinblue) is an all-in-one platform offering email marketing, automation, CRM, SMS, chat, and more to help manage customer relationships. Trusted by over 500,000 customers worldwide, Brevo provides tools for smarter marketing, sales, and customer conversations, including pipeline management, chat, phone, a universal inbox, customer data analytics, and messaging APIs. Users can get started for free and leverage a comprehensive suite of features to grow their business efficiently.

Name: Brut.
Description: Brut. offers concise video coverage on politics, society, culture, and sexuality from the U.S. and worldwide. Their platform features exclusive interviews and stories, including one with Eric Nam, a U.S.-born K-pop star discovered on YouTube. Nam discusses his journey as a crossover artist and the importance of representation. Follow Brut America's 100% video content for the latest news and insights.

Name: CertiDeal
Description: CertiDeal offers certified and reconditioned iPhones and Samsung smartphones with a 24-month warranty. Each device undergoes a 30-point inspection, ensuring 100% functionality. The reconditioning process is performed in France, and products are up to 70% cheaper than new ones. Buying reconditioned phones from CertiDeal saves money and supports environmental sustainability. The company provides detailed information, purchasing guides, and ongoing updates on its website. All devices are sourced from single-owner smartphones and reconditioned internally by experts.

Name: ClubFunding
Description: ClubFunding est une plateforme d'investissement immobilier via le crowdfunding, entièrement digitale et accessible de n'importe où. Elle permet aux utilisateurs de diversifier leur portefeuille et d'atteindre leurs objectifs financiers facilement. Les investisseurs bénéficient d'un espace personnalisé pour suivre leurs choix et de l'accompagnement par des conseillers experts. ClubFunding se distingue par son impact sur l'économie réelle et accompagne des porteurs de projets locaux. L'innovation et la proximité sont au cœur de ses solutions.

Name: Comet
Description: Comet connects businesses with the best IT freelancers for their projects within a day. With over 9,500 qualified profiles including developers, DevOps, IT architects, project managers, and more, Comet provides a tech-enabled solution to match talents to clients' specific needs. Over 60 major clients rely on Comet, which employs a selective evaluation program and a matching algorithm to ensure quality. Companies can easily find suitable freelancers by posting their missions on the platform.

Name: CorWave
Description: CorWave is a French company developing advanced cardiac assist devices, featuring a wave membrane pump that mimics healthy heart pulse and blood flow rates. This technology aims to reduce complications associated with current left ventricular assist devices (LVADs) and improve heart failure management. Founded in 2012, CorWave is a French Tech 120 member, backed by investors like Bpifrance and Novo Holdings. The company has raised over €80 million and employs over seventy people.

Name: Crosscall
Description: Crosscall is a French brand offering mobile phones and smartphones designed to be shock-resistant, waterproof, and highly durable, catering to outdoor enthusiasts and demanding professionals. Established with a focus on creating rugged devices, the company has grown significantly since its inception, featuring a dedicated team and advanced technology. Crosscall emphasizes durability and responsibility, offering a unique 5-year warranty and committing to sustainability. The brand operates internationally and continues to innovate from its headquarters in Aix-en-Provence.

Name: Deepki
Description: Deepki provides ESG data intelligence solutions to accelerate the transition towards net zero and sustainability in real estate. They offer resources like blogs, webinars, and white papers to help companies adopt successful ESG strategies. Deepki partners with organizations, such as Primonial REIM, to enhance portfolio value through comprehensive ESG practices. They monitor millions of square meters globally and have significantly reduced CO₂ emissions. Deepki also maintains a leadership position with continuous updates and achievements in the ESG sector.

Name: Descartes Underwriting
Description: Descartes Underwriting offers parametric insurance solutions to protect businesses against climate, cyber, and emerging risks. Using data-driven technology and expert teams, Descartes provides valuable capacity at stable premiums, even in high-risk areas. Their transparent coverage ensures swift payouts without ambiguity, and flexible policies offer financial freedom for clients. Descartes leverages advanced algorithms and vast data sources for better risk modeling, enhancing resilience for both corporate and public sector clients worldwide.

Name: Devialet
Description: Devialet offers high-end speakers and audiophile amplifiers for professionals with benefits like free UPS shipping, a 14-day return policy, secure payment, and a 2-year warranty. Users can subscribe for live updates from Devialet. The provided information will be used as per their Privacy Policy.

Name: Driiveme
Description: DriveMe simplifies vehicle relocation services across Europe, moving a vehicle every 36 seconds through convoyage, premium delivery, and automotive concierge services. They ensure swift driver allocation and promise exceptional customer experiences facilitated by custom service ecosystems. DriveMe efficiently manages fleet movements between different sites at competitive prices. The platform also offers a unique 1 euro rental solution for agencies to balance their vehicle fleets cost-effectively. Existing users can log in to access their services.

Name: Ekimetrics
Description: Ekimetrics is a leading firm in data science and AI-driven solutions aimed at enhancing sustainable business performance. With over 17 years of experience, they provide marketing measurement, customer insights, and predictive modeling to top brands like L'Oreal and Nestle. Their global team of over 400 experts combines business consulting with proprietary tech solutions to help companies simplify complex problems. Ekimetrics is recognized for its innovative approach and ability to deliver actionable insights.

Name: Exotrail
Description: Exotrail is an end-to-end space mobility operator focused on enabling small satellites to move in space, optimizing their deployment, increasing service performance, and reducing space pollution. The team comprises highly motivated scientists, engineers, managers, and graduates from top European institutions, working collaboratively in cross-functional teams. Committed to transparency, frequent delivery, and continuous improvement, Exotrail aims to excel in an industry marked by high responsibility and complexity.

Name: Flowdesk
Description: Flowdesk is a digital asset trading and technology firm offering regulated and transparent crypto financial services, including market making, OTC, and treasury management. Founded in 2020, Flowdesk integrates over 120 centralized and decentralized exchanges and supports over 400 assets. Their platform provides real-time strategy monitoring, emphasizing transparency and client control. Flowdesk aims to transform crypto finance with comprehensive infrastructure and non-custodial technologies, serving token issuers, exchanges, and institutions globally.

Name: Flying Whales
Description: FLYING WHALES offers an innovative airship-based transport solution within a new ecosystem. Their mission focuses on promoting economic development in remote areas and reducing the environmental impact of cargo transport. Their core objective is to make isolated regions more accessible.

Name: Foodles
Description: Foodles provides accessible workplace meals through self-service Smart Fridges stocked daily with chef-prepared, nutritious dishes. Catering to all dietary needs with seasonal, locally-sourced ingredients, their menus feature British and international cuisine. Employees benefit from 24/7 availability, a variety of meal options, and restaurant-quality dishes. Employers enjoy perks like reduced costs, flexibility, sustainability, and quick setup. Foodles enhances employee well-being and productivity by offering convenient, healthy meals at the workplace.

Name: Gojob
Description: Gojob is an interim recruitment agency offering over 50,000 job opportunities. Users can easily apply for nearby jobs and benefit from services like 10% remunerated savings and immediate advances. Gojob provides free online training and coaching support. The AI virtual assistant, Gojob Aglae, revolutionizes recruitment by continuously sourcing and matching candidates instantaneously. Annually, Gojob processes 2 million applications, manages 10,000 weekly AI conversations, and calculates 700 million matching scores.

Name: Greenly
Description: Greenly is an all-in-one platform designed to help businesses measure, manage, and reduce their CO2 emissions. More than 2000 companies use Greenly for their environmental transition. It offers tools for measuring emissions, analyzing carbon impact, and training employees on climate issues. Greenly ensures data security with SOC and ISO 27001 certifications and provides comprehensive reporting aligned with GHG Protocol standards. Users can also access climate strategy ratings, expert advice, and a diverse catalog of carbon contribution projects.

Name: Groupe positive
Description: Sarbacane offers a comprehensive digital communication solution, including email and SMS marketing, automation, and personalized consulting services. The online application features tools for creating forms, web pages, and automated prospecting, along with contact management and live chat options. Users can access over 100 responsive email templates and customize them easily using the intuitive EmailBuilder. This high-end service provides expert marketing strategy support and centralized communication management.

Name: HappyVore
Description: HappyVore offers a range of plant-based and gourmet products made in France, including vegan steaks, sausages, and merguez. These products are available for home delivery or in stores.

Name: HelloCSE
Description: HelloCSE is a leading French provider of employee benefits solutions, offering over 300,000 preferental deals with discounts up to 80%. Their mobile app ensures 24/7 access to exclusive CSE offers, helping employees save over €1000 annually. Renowned for responsiveness and personalized service, HelloCSE has earned high customer satisfaction ratings and is trusted by over 4000 CSEs. Their services are GDPR-compliant and feature a diverse advantage catalogue, serving all employees effectively and conveniently.

Name: HOMA
Description: Homa is a gaming technology lab that provides game creators with data-driven tools and expertise to turn creative ideas into commercial hits. Homa Lab offers real-time data analysis, market insights, and a powerful mobile SDK for testing and optimizing games. The Homa Academy educates developers on game design, ideation, and player experience. Homa operates globally with a diverse team, emphasizing flexibility and collaboration. The company aims to revolutionize gaming by integrating data and creativity.

Name: Hoppen
Description: Groupe HOPPEN is a French leader in phygital patient support, assisting 1 in 2 patients during their healthcare journey. The organization focuses on enhancing the comfort and well-being of hospitalized individuals and their families, while also aiding healthcare workers to free up time for patient care.

Name: ImCheck Therapeutics
Description: ImCheck Therapeutics is pioneering advancements in immuno-oncology by leveraging expertise in the butyrophilin and BTN-like superfamily of checkpoint molecules. The company develops next-generation immunotherapeutic antibodies targeting cancer, infectious diseases, and autoimmune disorders. They are set to present promising ICT01 data at ASCO 2024 and have been recognized for their potential in healthcare innovation.

Name: iSupplier
Description: iSupplier is a company specializing in the optimization of service procurement for businesses. Their SaaS-based multiservice solution helps streamline vendor management and sourcing through a dedicated marketplace. Certified ISO 27001 since 2020 for data security, iSupplier ensures timely administrative management and payments. With over 100,000 experts and operations in more than 25 countries, they have a strong focus on transparency, client satisfaction, and environmental responsibility, partnering with Reforest’Action to plant trees for every engagement.

Name: ITEN
Description: ITEN specializes in developing, manufacturing, and selling fast-rechargeable solid-state micro-batteries in the form of Surface Mounted Devices (SMD). Founded in 2011, the company targets high-scale integration, data security, and low manufacturing costs for various electronics industries. ITEN's micro-batteries are easy to assemble and recycle, making them ideal for applications such as wireless sensors, smartcards, and medical devices. Headquartered in Dardilly, France, ITEN prioritizes performance, quality, and environmental responsibility.

Name: La Belle Vie
Description: La Belle Vie offers same-day grocery delivery across Île-de-France, seven days a week from 8 AM to 11 PM. They provide a wide range of products, including items such as beef steak from Maison Conquet, and various groceries available at discounted prices.

Name: La Fourche
Description: La Fourche est un magasin bio en ligne proposant des produits écologiques et naturels à des prix réduits de 25% à 50%. Ils offrent un essai gratuit de 30 jours pour découvrir leurs réductions annuelles via une adhésion annuelle de 59,90€, qui permet de bénéficier de tarifs imbattables sur une gamme de plus de 4000 produits français. La livraison est gratuite à partir de 69€ d'achats, réalisée de manière écoresponsable.

Name: Le Collectionist
Description: Le Collectionist, fondé en 2012, propose des villas de luxe et chalets à louer avec des services exceptionnels et des expériences sur-mesure. Leur Collection Iconique regroupe des maisons exclusives, toutes accompagnées d'une conciergerie dédiée pour un service personnalisé. L'équipe de conseillers aide à trouver la maison idéale, tandis que les Tailors créent des expériences authentiques. Le respect de la confidentialité et une satisfaction client élevée sont prioritaires. Les équipes locales restent disponibles pendant le séjour.

Name: LeHibou
Description: LeHibou is a freelance IT platform that connects IT consultants with ambitious companies. They offer over 300 new missions weekly.

Name: Leocare
Description: Leocare is an online insurance provider for auto, motorcycle, home, and mobile. They offer fast quotes and customizable policies via their mobile app, allowing users to adjust coverage with a single click. Claims can be tracked and filed through the app for quick indemnification. Holding the "Service France Garanti" label, Leocare provides comprehensive and personalized support with options to contact customer service through multiple channels. Their services include competitive pricing and detailed coverage plans.

Name: Libon
Description: Libon is a multi-service app enabling users to make international calls and top-up mobile, internet, and electricity accounts for their loved ones. Offering services in 160 countries, Libon has garnered a solid reputation with 8 million users globally. It is recognized for its excellent communication quality and transparent pricing. Available on Apple AppStore and Google Play Store, Libon is a favorite for supporting family remotely with reliable services at competitive rates. Founded in 2018, Libon is a leading French Tech company.

Name: Lifen
Description: Lifen leverages data intelligence to support healthcare professionals. Users can explore the benefits and fill out their information to receive customized solutions from Lifen's commercial team.

Name: LumApps
Description: LumApps is a modern intranet solution that connects employees to their organization, enhancing engagement and work efficiency from any location. It offers integrated tools for effective communication, IT simplification, and HR support, leveraging AI for personalization and automation. Recognized by Forrester and trusted by Google and Microsoft, LumApps provides seamless integrations with Google Workspace and Microsoft 365. Founded in 2015, LumApps operates globally with a mission to foster a connected and purposeful digital workplace.

Name: Sumeria (ex-Lydia)
Description: Sumeria is a comprehensive French online banking service that includes a current account with 4% interest, shared accounts, and budgeting tools. Users benefit from instant transactions, monthly interest payments, and up to €100,000 FGDR protection. Sumeria also allows the connection of other bank accounts for comprehensive financial management. Lydia Solutions developed Sumeria to simplify mobile banking in Europe, promoting a cashless society. Key partners include Monext, Marqeta, Budget Insight, Tink, and Floa.

Name: Madbox
Description: Madbox is a game development company formed by the merger of two studios, Chou Entertainment and MadJoh, in 2018. They aim to create engaging experiences for players worldwide, boasting over 400 million downloads. Known for hit games like Stickman Hook, Madbox emphasizes creativity and rapid game iteration. The company values a casual yet ambitious culture and continues to innovate in the gaming industry, with a strong focus on pure gameplay and core loops.

Name: Matawan
Description: Matawan: MAAS is a digital platform supporting intermodal travel with a single mobility pass, collaborating with communities and operators to enhance user services and reduce environmental footprints.

Name: Medadom
Description: MEDADOM is a rapidly growing e-health startup and the first teleconsultation company approved by the French Ministry of Health. It offers a comprehensive teleconsultation solution via web/mobile apps and connected kiosks, enabling easy access to general practitioners without prior appointments. Founded in 2017 by Elie-Dan and Charles Mimouni, and engineer Nathaniel Bern, MEDADOM addresses healthcare access inequalities in France. It boasts 3.8 million consultations, 4500 kiosks, high satisfaction ratings, 850 partner doctors, over 100 employees, and has raised €40 million. MEDADOM is a French Tech 120 member for four consecutive years.

Name: Mooncard
Description: Mooncard offers integrated expense management solutions for businesses, featuring customizable corporate payment cards and real-time expense tracking. The platform simplifies professional expense management from payment to accounting, with automated expense reports and flexible mobility cards. Mooncard supports companies of all sizes, providing secure and configurable payment options that streamline administrative tasks and VAT recovery. Over 6,000 enterprises utilize Mooncard, highlighting its efficiency and adaptability. Customer support is available weekdays to tailor solutions to specific business needs.

Name: Moon surgical
Description: Moon Surgical focuses on empowering surgeons with advanced technology. Their Maestro System aims to enhance operating room efficiency and surgical care. The blended French-American leadership team at Moon Surgical is dedicated to innovating the future of surgery in a fast-paced, focused environment.

Name: Mylight150
Description: Mylight150 offers advanced solar solutions for energy self-consumption, maximizing photovoltaic energy production with cutting-edge panels. Their intelligent ecosystem includes MySmartBattery and MySmartHeatPump, optimizing energy storage and consumption. Focusing on reducing energy bills and increasing autonomy, Mylight150 provides efficient solar technology for both professionals and individuals.

Name: MYM
Description: MYM is an exclusive social network where users can follow their favorite personalities and access exclusive content. It offers a unique relationship between fans and celebrities, allowing for recognition, engagement, and personalized content creation. MYM includes various profiles in fields such as astrology and mediumship, offering users the opportunity to connect closely with stars through photos, videos, and live sessions. The platform also provides a creator program, customer support, and comprehensive policies for user protection.

Name: Opteamis
Description: Opteamis connects top IT and digital professionals with forward-thinking companies. The platform aids IT buyers and managers in finding and contracting the best providers in just 24-48 hours. It supports ESNs, SSII, and consulting firms in staffing needs, with access to over 400 calls for tender per month and a CV database of over 250,000 profiles. Freelancers can find job opportunities, manage contracts, and invoicing directly through the platform, which serves over 700 clients and 50 major groups.

Name: Ornikar
Description: Ornikar is a modern driving school and auto insurance provider. They offer driving lessons at 35% lower costs and auto insurance starting from €9 per month. The platform includes interactive live sessions to help learners prepare for their driving exams. Ornikar aims to enhance access to mobility and autonomy for young people, providing comprehensive support for driving theory and practical training, along with fair and tailored auto insurance.

Name: Pasqal
Description: Pasqal leverages Nobel Prize-winning technology and a full-stack approach to provide cutting-edge quantum solutions. Focusing on real-world applications, Pasqal uses neutral-atoms technology to address significant challenges in quantum computing. With over four decades of experience, the company possesses the state's leading technology, methodology, and talent. Pasqal's team of scientists, researchers, and engineers works collaboratively to make quantum computing a practical reality for businesses worldwide.

Name: PerfectStay
Description: PerfectStay provides a wide selection of Flight + Hotel offers at the best prices. Travelers can benefit from up to 70% off on irresistible deals and flash sales. The company guarantees the best prices, offering double the difference if a cheaper price is found elsewhere. Payment can be made in installments, and a vacation guarantee covers unforeseen events. PerfectStay also offers easy booking, comprehensive travel planning, and 24/7 customer support. Over 700,000 travelers have trusted their services.

Name: Planity
Description: Planity is an online platform that allows users to book appointments at hair salons, beauty institutes, barbershops, and spas across France, available 24/7 with immediate confirmation. Users can conveniently schedule and manage appointments, receiving SMS reminders and the ability to modify or cancel bookings. Professionals benefit from an integrated scheduling system. Planity ensures quality by partnering with select establishments, offering a streamlined service experience without the need for phone calls or physical visits.

Name: Platform.sh
Description: Platform.sh offers an all-in-one Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS) designed to accelerate development and deployment processes. It provides automated infrastructure provisioning, multicloud support, and scalability, catering to over 5,000 global customers. The platform ensures security through rigorous compliance measures and optimizes workflows using Git-based processes. With features like Observability Suite and auto-scaling, it aims to enhance performance and reduce resource consumption, contributing to carbon-conscious computing. Notably, clients like Burst and SportRx have significantly benefited from its solutions. Platform.sh is committed to innovation and environmental sustainability.

Name: PlayPlay
Description: PlayPlay offers an online video creation tool for businesses, enabling users to produce professional videos quickly without editing skills. The platform features a drag-and-drop interface, automatic subtitling, premium stock library, and customizable templates to ensure consistent branding. Suitable for large teams, it facilitates efficient collaboration and user authorizations. PlayPlay's tools have been praised for increasing content output and engagement, with a 7-day free trial available for new users.

Name: Prophesee
Description: Prophesee is a leader in neuromorphic vision systems, offering the advanced Metavision technology inspired by human vision. Their event-based vision sensors capture dynamic scenes with high temporal resolution and manage extreme lighting conditions efficiently. Prophesee's technology improves machine intelligence, autonomy, and safety. Applications span across autonomous vehicles, industrial automation, IoT, mobile, and AR/VR. The company collaborates with major tech firms like AMD and Qualcomm and has garnered over 60 international recognitions and 95+ patents.

Name: Seyna
Description: Seyna offers a comprehensive platform combining technology and insurance for brokers, enabling them to create customized insurance products and provide personalized client experiences. Seyna supports insurance product creation, subscription optimization, real-time portfolio tracking, policy management, compliance, and claims management. The platform is hosted on AWS for reliability and integrates with partners like Munich RE and Tessi. Seyna's team includes entrepreneurs, insurance, and technology experts dedicated to transforming the insurance industry.

Name: Shares
Description: Shares is an investment platform enabling users to invest in over 1,500 stocks and learn from current investors. It is an appointed representative of RiskSave Technologies Ltd, regulated by the FCA. Client funds are safeguarded by the FCA-regulated firm Modulr and US investments are protected up to $500,000 by the SIPC. The platform ensures data security using AES 256-bit encryption and a dedicated Data Security & Protection team.

Name: Singulart
Description: SINGULART is an online art gallery featuring original artworks from globally recognized artists. It offers a 1-year return policy, ensuring customer satisfaction. The platform provides fine art, modern, and contemporary pieces, verified for authenticity with a certificate. Deliveries are typically within 7-10 days and orders are fully insured. SINGULART promotes inclusivity with nearly half of its represented artists being women and hosts the annual SINGULART Awards to spotlight emerging talent. They also support charity through auctions for Médecins du Monde.

Name: SiPearl
Description: SiPearl designs high-performance, low-power European microprocessors for supercomputing and AI inference. The company aims to address critical challenges in medicine, security, energy, and climate by processing vast amounts of strategic data rapidly. Participating in key industry events like Forum Teratec, VivaTech, and ISC High Performance, SiPearl contributes to Europe's technological sovereignty with a reduced carbon footprint. Their newsletter provides updates on development milestones and upcoming events.

Name: SparingVision
Description: SparingVision is a genomic medicines company focused on revolutionizing the treatment of ocular diseases, particularly Inherited Retinal Diseases (IRDs) like Retinitis Pigmentosa (RP). They go beyond single gene correction therapies to deliver mutation-independent treatments. Their lead product, SPVN06, leverages extensive ophthalmic research and expert collaboration. By harnessing gene therapy and genome editing, SparingVision aims to make significant advancements in ocular disease treatment and improve patient outcomes. The company also ensures user privacy by employing necessary and analytical cookies on their website.

Name: Swan
Description: Swan provides APIs and white-label interfaces to seamlessly integrate banking features like accounts, cards, and payments into products. It offers customized solutions, manages regulatory compliance, and ensures transaction security through its own infrastructure, connected to the SEPA network. Swan's platform allows rapid deployment and testing without setup costs, supported by a dedicated team of banking and tech experts. Recently, Swan raised €37m and aims to become a leading European banking platform by enabling fintech innovation.

Name: Sweep
Description: Sweep offers a comprehensive sustainability data management platform to help businesses track and act on their ESG and carbon emissions. Founded in 2020 with headquarters in France and the UK, Sweep streamlines the process of monitoring, disclosing, and managing sustainability data. It aids in compliance with international ESG standards and regulations and facilitates seamless audit preparations. Sweep's platform empowers organizations to effectively set and achieve their sustainability goals while reducing their carbon footprint through data-driven strategies.

Name: TapNation
Description: TapNation is a mobile game publisher that has assisted over 100 game developers in generating more than 1 billion downloads. Founded in 2019, the company focuses on creativity and uses advanced technologies like AI and machine learning to enhance gaming experiences. Boasting a diverse and international team, TapNation has released 50+ games and attracted millions of players globally. They aim to lead the mobile gaming market with innovative and entertaining content.

Name: Tissium
Description: TISSIUM specializes in advanced tissue reconstruction using proprietary biomorphic programmable polymers. Founded in 2013, TISSIUM develops innovative solutions aiming to revolutionize surgical procedures by restoring natural tissue function. The company integrates technology platforms with development, commercialization, and manufacturing for internal programs and partnerships. Its leadership team includes experts with extensive backgrounds in engineering, molecular biology, finance, bioengineering, strategy, and medical device industries.

Name: TreeFrog Therapeutics
Description: TreeFrog Therapeutics specializes in iPS-derived cell therapies aiming to make treatments safer, more efficient, and affordable. The company has been recognized for its innovative work, winning accolades such as the Best Poster Award at the ISCT Annual Meeting for its Parkinson’s disease program. Key team members include CEO Frédéric Desdouits, CTO Kévin Alessandri, and CSO Maxime Feyeux. Their proprietary C-Stem™ technology allows for scalable production of high-quality induced pluripotent stem cells.

Name: Umiami
Description: Umiami is a leading foodtech company specializing in plant-based fillets, offering alternatives to meat and fish with less than 10 ingredients. Founded in 2022, Umiami employs a unique proprietary technology called "umisation" to create large-scale plant-based fillets mimicking the taste and texture of animal meat. The company collaborates with food manufacturers and restaurant owners to promote plant-based products. Umiami is recognized for its commitment to sustainability, innovation, and employee satisfaction.

Name: Unseenlabs
Description: Unseenlabs provides advanced ship tracking technology for the maritime sector, using satellite detection of electromagnetic signatures to offer real-time data. Founded in 2015 in Brittany, France, by brothers Clément and Jonathan Galic, the company is the European leader in radio frequency signal processing. Unseenlabs aims to improve maritime surveillance for various entities, including maritime agencies, insurance firms, and governments. Key personnel include Clément Galic (CEO), Jonathan Galic (CTO), Benjamin Galic, and Olivier Michel.

Name: Ultra Premium
Description: Ultra Premium Direct offers high-quality dog and cat food with savings up to 40%. Their range includes premium kibble, pâtés, and treats made in France, using high-quality ingredients without cereals. They provide express delivery within 24/48 hours and a subscription service for an additional 10% discount. The company focuses on the well-being of pets with balanced, natural diet recipes. Products are manufactured in the South of France to ensure superior quality. Join the #UltraPremiumDirect community.

Name: Virtuo
Description: Virtuo offers contactless car rentals in the UK and Europe, allowing users to book and unlock vehicles via an app, with 24/7 access and support. The service includes free cancellation and the flexibility of extending rentals. Virtuo promotes eco-friendliness by reducing emissions and aims to electrify its fleet by 2030. Business users can benefit from dedicated tools for streamlined booking and payment management.

Name: Volta Medical
Description: Volta is an AI solutions company focused on assessing complex arrhythmia pathologies. The company utilizes the VoltaPlex data collection ecosystem to support machine learning methodologies validated by physicians, resulting in the development of Volta’s Companion AI technology, Volta AF-Xplorer™. Founded in 2016, Volta aims to improve the clinical success rates of ablation procedures for persistent AF through AI. The company has raised over €90M and has a strong AI product pipeline and proven capabilities in clinical trials.

Name: Waat
Description: WAAT is a French operator of charging stations, catering to condominiums, social landlords, commercial real estate, and businesses. They are a 2024 French Tech 120 and Ecovadis "Entreprise Engagée" awardee. Their MyWAAT mobile app is unique in the market. Services include technical studies, provision of connected stations, installation for indoor/outdoor parking, preventive maintenance, and supervision. Their "Confort" offer for condominiums, partnered with Logivolt and Advenir, covers 100% installation costs with no fund calls or management by the syndic. WAAT handles all aspects.

Name: WeMaintain
Description: WeMaintain offers comprehensive maintenance solutions for real estate actors, focusing on improving building performance. Their services include on-field operations, data management, and connected devices, promising a 25% reduction in maintenance costs and enhanced transparency. Key features include dedicated technicians, real-time data monitoring, and preventive maintenance. WeMaintain ensures efficient operations, better tenant satisfaction, and extends equipment lifespan, all while improving asset management and reducing maintenance issues significantly. Recognized as a B Corp member, WeMaintain emphasizes quality and reliability.

Name: Worldia
Description: Worldia is a next-generation connected-trip operator that enables travel distributors to offer customized trips and stand out in the market. Founded in 2013, it operates with a team of over 130 experts in Paris and Berlin. Worldia provides a white-label travel planning service with curated products and on-demand support, ensuring a seamless end-to-end booking experience. Their platform allows for quick trip customization, aiming to boost performance and reduce time to market in the digital age.

Name: Ynsect
Description: Ynsect is a world leader in insect ingredient production, aiming to make food systems more nutritious and sustainable. They produce insect-based feed, food, and fertilizer alternatives, and were the first to get approval to commercialize mealworm proteins for dog food in the U.S. Ynsect is focused on countering imported deforestation and supporting environmental goals through innovative and sustainable practices. The company values teamwork, adaptation, and creative solutions to tackle global food and environmental challenges.

Name: Zeplug
Description: Zeplug provides a hassle-free solution for installing electric vehicle charging stations in shared residential and corporate settings. They offer a service that includes consultation, technical studies, installation, certification, and maintenance, using 100% renewable energy. Zeplug caters to residents, property managers, businesses, and real estate developers. Their intelligent charging management system helps balance electricity consumption. Zeplug's solutions are compatible with all rechargeable vehicles, with over 1 million households and 1,000 property managers already using their services.
